title: Inspection Crew Tariff Note: Home-Size Addition to the In-Place Home Resale Inspection Charge
content:
**Tariff note — home size.** On an In-Place Home Resale package whose inspection fee is above 0.00, the initial inspection charge carries a home-size addition, one of the inspection additions billed with that charge. The home-size addition follows the home recorded on the seller's Home-Site Lease: a multi-section home of 64 feet or longer adds 55.00, a multi-section home shorter than 64 feet adds 40.00, and a single-section home adds nothing.

The section type and the home length in feet are read from the home as the seller's Home-Site Lease records it.

| Home on the Home-Site Lease | Length | Home-size addition |
|---|---|---|
| multi-section | 64 feet or longer | 55.00 |
| multi-section | shorter than 64 feet | 40.00 |
| single-section | any length | 0.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical homes)

| Home | Addition |
|---|---|
| multi-section, 64 feet | 55.00 (64 feet is "64 feet or longer") |
| multi-section, 63.5 feet | 40.00 |
| multi-section, 76 feet | 55.00 |
| single-section, 80 feet | 0.00 (single-section homes add nothing whatever their length) |
